events.content:
Migration complete. Summary of changes:

- **`app/layout.tsx`** — new root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`, replacing `pages/_app.tsx` and `pages/_document.tsx`. Shared metadata (title/description/viewport/favicon) moved into the `metadata`/`viewport` exports.
- **`app/page.tsx`** — migrated from `pages/index.tsx`; dropped `next/head` in favor of the layout's metadata (index page had no unique metadata).
- **`app/about/page.tsx`** — migrated from `pages/about.tsx`; page-specific title/description now exported as a `metadata` object instead of `<Head>`.
- Removed the entire `pages/` directory (`_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`, `index.tsx`, `about.tsx`).
- Verified with `npm run build` (compiles, prerenders `/`, `/about`, `/_not-found` as static) and a `next start` smoke test confirming both routes render the correct HTML, titles, and meta descriptions.

No routing/import changes were needed elsewhere since this was a two-page site with no shared components or data fetching to convert.

content.text:
Migration complete. Summary of changes:

- **`app/layout.tsx`** — new root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`, replacing `pages/_app.tsx` and `pages/_document.tsx`. Shared metadata (title/description/viewport/favicon) moved into the `metadata`/`viewport` exports.
- **`app/page.tsx`** — migrated from `pages/index.tsx`; dropped `next/head` in favor of the layout's metadata (index page had no unique metadata).
- **`app/about/page.tsx`** — migrated from `pages/about.tsx`; page-specific title/description now exported as a `metadata` object instead of `<Head>`.
- Removed the entire `pages/` directory (`_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`, `index.tsx`, `about.tsx`).
- Verified with `npm run build` (compiles, prerenders `/`, `/about`, `/_not-found` as static) and a `next start` smoke test confirming both routes render the correct HTML, titles, and meta descriptions.

No routing/import changes were needed elsewhere since this was a two-page site with no shared components or data fetching to convert.
